calls.title: GB x Boyle Sports: FF & Exp Training
calls.summary: The meeting covered the team's readiness for experimentation with GrowthBook, specifically highlighting the need for a training session to boost confidence in using the platform. Joe Taylor emphasized the shift from Qubit and the necessity for proper experiment setup and interpretation of outcomes, while Chris Sanders explained basic concepts of feature flags and their role in experiments. The discussion also included importance of precise targeting for compliance experiments, with metrics like verification-to-deposit rate defined as primary indicators of success. Participants stressed the need for consistent user IDs to maintain data integrity and the use of GrowthBook's power calculator for planning future experiments. Collaborative follow-up sessions were scheduled to refine experiment designs and ensure alignment across teams.
calls.keywords: feature flags, experimentation, Growthbook, A/B testing, traffic bucketing, power calculations
